candidates.label: US10266548:extract_from_tables
candidates.diagnosis: The table has a multi-row header where assay names and units are split across rows, and the data rows themselves are split across multiple XML rows when a compound has multiple sub-assays or cell lines. The first row of a compound holds the ID and some assay values; continuation rows have a blank ID but hold additional assay values for the same compound. The current code skips blank-ID rows entire
